audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real cooldown numbers for Cosmic Radiance or Dazzle; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are the tradeGood/tradeBad lines copy-pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Cosmic Radiance (R) is 180/150/120s and Dazzle (E) is 16/15/14/13/12s per enemyKit — those numbers make the advice actionable (the untargetable-dodges-burst missing interaction is about the R's delay-then-invuln window).
audit.corrected: See edits: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with real R/E timing, dosFull[1].d rewritten around Dazzle's cooldown, dontsFull[2].d rewritten around not dumping R into an up Radiance.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Cosmic Radiance (R) is 180/150/120s — burst before the delayed invuln lands or wait it out; that timer gates every all-in. - Dazzle (E) is down 16s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — his only lockdown, punish it hard. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play.

edits.before: E the cover-line, Q the rooted pile, auto the passive — the lane's longest pick paid in pairs.
edits.after: Dazzle is a slow line stun — sidestep it with W speed, then punish him during the 16-12s it's down.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
edits.after: Don't dump R into an up Cosmic Radiance — bait it or wait the invuln out first.
